narration: Eight in the morning, and a corporate group is checking out. The bill shows the walk-in room rate, not the group rate, and the queue keeps growing. With Operra, the group's room rate is saved with the booking, so the folio is right before the guest reaches the desk. Settled, and on time.

scenes.image: A bright corporate hotel lobby in the early morning, tall glass windows looking out over a harbour with container cranes. Business travellers seen from behind wait with rolling suitcases beside a polished stone reception counter. Crisp morning light, cinematic photograph, shallow depth of field.

scenes.line: Walk-in rate on a group bill.
scenes.image: Close view of a polished wooden hotel reception counter in the morning: a brass bell, a small vase of white flowers, and a guest's hand resting impatiently on the wood beside a set of room keys. Tense mood, shallow depth of field, cinematic photograph.
A quiet hotel back office at dusk with a wooden desk, a potted palm and warm lamp light falling on a woven basket, soft focus, cinematic photograph.

scenes.line: The right room rate, every time.
scenes.image: An empty, tidy hotel reception desk in late morning sun, fresh flowers in a vase, polished wood, calm and orderly, cinematic photograph.

scenes.line: Paid, and out the door on time.
scenes.image: Business travellers seen from behind walking out through tall glass doors of a harbour-front hotel toward a waiting car in bright midday sun, relaxed, cinematic photograph.
